name: Phoenix
introduction: is the mythical bird that rises from its own ashes, introduced by Dutch navigators in the 1590s. It lies in the southern sky near Achernar.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: [Ankaa](hip:2081), the brightest star, is an orange giant 82 light-years away. Its name, from Arabic, refers to a legendary bird.
In 1956, an unexpected meteor shower, the Phoenicids, burst from this region.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Beta Phoenicis](hip:5165) is a pair of yellow giants. [Gamma Phoenicis](hip:6867) is a red giant, and [Wurren](hip:5348) an eclipsing binary of two blue stars.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: Phoenix looks out of the Milky Way. In this direction lies the Phoenix Cluster, a massive galaxy cluster whose central galaxy forms stars at an extraordinary rate, and Robert’s Quartet, four interacting galaxies.
